decisions.label: Grade 1
decisions.description: A morphologic qualifier indicating that a cancerous lesion is well differentiated.

verification.note: NCIT:C28077 Grade 1; label is 'Grade 1' rather than 'G1' abbreviation, but is the standard NCIT histologic grade qualifier for well-differentiated tumors (equivalent to G1).

decisions.label: Grade 2
decisions.description: A morphologic qualifier indicating that a cancerous lesion is moderately differentiated.

verification.note: NCIT:C28078 Grade 2; label is 'Grade 2' rather than 'G2' abbreviation, but is the standard NCIT histologic grade qualifier for moderately differentiated tumors (equivalent to G2).

decisions.label: Grade 3
decisions.description: A morphologic qualifier indicating that a cancerous lesion is poorly differentiated.

verification.note: NCIT:C28079 Grade 3; label is 'Grade 3' rather than 'G3' abbreviation, but is the standard NCIT histologic grade qualifier for poorly differentiated tumors (equivalent to G3).

decisions.label: Grade 4
decisions.description: A morphologic qualifier indicating that a cancerous lesion is undifferentiated.

verification.note: NCIT:C28082 Grade 4; label is 'Grade 4' rather than 'G4' abbreviation, but is the standard NCIT histologic grade qualifier for undifferentiated tumors (equivalent to G4).

decisions.label: Grade X
decisions.description: A morphologic qualifier indicating that the grade of a neoplasm cannot be assessed.

verification.note: NCIT:C113730 Grade X; label uses 'Grade X' rather than 'GX' abbreviation but is the standard NCIT term for grade-cannot-be-assessed, which is the conventional meaning of GX in tumor grading.

decisions.label: Grade B
decisions.description: A morphologic qualifier indicating that a neoplasm is of borderline malignancy.

verification.note: NCIT:C113729 Grade B; label is 'Grade B' rather than 'GB' abbreviation. Used for borderline malignancy grade in some tumor types. Best available NCIT match.

decisions.label: High Grade
decisions.description: A morphologic qualifier indicating that a neoplasm is poorly differentiated or undifferentiated (Grade 3 or Grade 4).

verification.note: NCIT:C14158 High Grade; confirmed as the parent class of Grade 3 (C28079) and Grade 4 (C28082) histologic grade qualifiers. Label is an exact match. Definition inferred from its children.

decisions.label: Unknown
decisions.description: Not known, observed, recorded, or reported as unknown by the data contributor.

verification.note: NCIT:C43234 Not Reported; standard NCIT qualifier.

decisions.label: Not Applicable
decisions.description: Determination of a value is not relevant in the current context.

verification.note: NCIT:C48660 Not Applicable; standard NCIT qualifier.
